query: aimdo's vbar_allocate (src/model-vbar.c:222-227) clamps each VBAR VA reservation to vram_capacity, so on large-VRAM ROCm/Windows devices every model >=1/10 of device capacity reserves the full capacity of address space; three models (LTX video+TE+VAE) exhaust the ~256 GiB per-process GPU VA space and sampling fails with hipErrorOutOfMemory while 60-82 GB VRAM is free.

desired.outcome: OP demonstrated that changing one multiplier in ComfyUI (the ModelVBAR(self.model_size() * 10, ...) reservation in model_patcher.py _vbar_get) takes peak usage on a 43 GiB LTX workflow from 26,978 MB to 81,522 MB and turns the hard failure into a clean run (OP-confirmed measurement in issue body). No upstream aimdo fix confirmed yet; merged PR #78 (NVML pressure and async pre-free clamping) was bot-linked as related but not confirmed to fix this.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.
desired.answer_guidance: OP demonstrated that changing one multiplier in ComfyUI (the ModelVBAR(self.model_size() * 10, ...) reservation in model_patcher.py _vbar_get) takes peak usage on a 43 GiB LTX workflow from 26,978 MB to 81,522 MB and turns the hard failure into a clean run (OP-confirmed measurement in issue body). No upstream aimdo fix confirmed yet; merged PR #78 (NVML pressure and async pre-free clamping) was bot-linked as related but not confirmed to fix this.
desired.guidance_note: Known fix from the original issue thread. Use to verify the diagnosis targets the right root cause; alternative fixes that resolve the same root cause are acceptable.

_tags.hidden_requirement: Reason about GPU virtual-address-space reservation math (VBAR clamping to capacity) and validate a one-multiplier core patch with a measured before/after, not intuition.
